forbidden_validation_data: a re-export or subset of the discovery cohort

required_real_measurements: initial genetic background m fixed before evolution
eligible_external_dataset.exclusion: no criterion may be changed after opening outcome R

frozen_primary_analysis.candidate: same ridge X plus initial genetic background m
frozen_primary_analysis.validation: replicate-position folds within background; no population crosses folds

success_rule_all_required: relative RMSE gain is at least 20 percent
95 percent genetic-background bootstrap interval excludes zero
one-sided stratified permutation p is at most 0.05
effect direction is positive in every prespecified experimental batch

public_registration.reason: repository change has not been pushed or archived publicly
public_registration.must_precede: opening any eligible external outcome data
